prompt: Evaluate this molecule for drug potential: CC(C)Cc1ccc(cc1)C(C)C(=O)O (that's the SMILES for ibuprofen, but pretend you don't know that)

assertions.name: handles_smiles_input
assertions.check: Analysis creates molecule from SMILES string without requiring name lookup

assertions.name: includes_qed_score
assertions.check: Output contains QED score (Quantitative Estimate of Drug-likeness)

assertions.name: includes_lipinski
assertions.check: Output mentions Lipinski's Rule of Five and indicates violations

assertions.name: provides_assessment_without_name
assertions.description: Provides assessment even without knowing molecule name
assertions.check: Analysis is complete even though molecule name was not provided
